EC1: The patient is participating in another study
EC2: The patient is in an exclusion period determined by a previous study
EC3: The patient or his/her representative refuses to sign the consent
EC4: It is impossible to correctly inform the patient or his/her representative
EC5: The patient is pregnant or breastfeeding
EC6: The patient has a contraindication (or an incompatible drug association) for a treatment used in this study
EC7: The patient had a coronary stent for less than 12 months
EC8: The patient does [NOT] not require treatment with aspirin [OR] or any other antiplatelet agent
EC9: The patient has a history of aspirin [AND] allergy
EC10: High bleeding risk; such as platelets [OR] <50,000 / mm3 during screening, Hb [OR] <8.5 g / dL, history of intracranial hemorrhage [OR] or subdural hematoma [OR], major surgery, [OR] parenchymal organ biopsy [OR] or severe trauma [OR] within 30 days before inclusion, active gastrointestinal ulcer in the last 3 months;
EC11: History of Stroke in the last 3 months;
EC12: Moderate [OR] or severe liver affection associated with coagulopathy
EC14: Active tumor [AND] treated at the time of inclusion associated with expected survival less than one year
